Which payment handlers do stores declare in their UCP profile?

In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, of the 951 stores that publish a UCP profile, 270 declare Google Pay (com.google.pay), 263 declare the Shopify card handler (dev.shopify.card), 263 declare Shop Pay (dev.shopify.shop_pay) and 1 declares Klarna (com.klarna.payments). 270 declare at least one payment handler and 681 declare none. A declared handler is a line in the profile, not proof that an agent can pay.

Combinations stores declare

A store can declare more than one handler, so the handler counts above overlap.

Shopify card handler (263)

Shop Pay (263)

Big retailers: Asprey, FAO Schwarz, Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Mexx, On AG, Pepco, Quiksilver and The Body Shop. The profile id is dev.shopify.shop_pay.

Klarna (1)

Shop Pay and Google Pay are declarations in the profile, the same as any other handler. Which stores declare UCP checkout. How we measure.

Does a declared payment handler mean an agent can pay?

No. A declared handler is a line in the published UCP profile. ShopBot Index does not test purchases.
